definition.title: Moody's Seasoned Baa Corporate Bond Yield Relative to Yield on 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity

BAA10Y.interpretation: Baa corporate yield minus ten-year Treasury yield in percentage points, stored by FRED as Percent. This is not an option-adjusted spread or a duration-matched hedge quote.
BAA10Y.label: Moody's Seasoned Baa Corporate Bond Yield Relative to Yield on 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity

CCSA.interpretation: Insured unemployment claims for continued benefits, seasonally adjusted; reference week ends Saturday. Continued claims are already represented in WEI and arrive for a different latest reference week.
CCSA.label: Continued Claims (Insured Unemployment)

GDPNOW.interpretation: Atlanta Fed model estimate of annualized quarterly real GDP growth. The observation identifies the target quarter, not the forecast publication day. FRED current-quarter values revise; historical quarters contain final model estimates, not a complete forecast-vintage path.
GDPNOW.label: GDPNow

ICSA.interpretation: New claims for unemployment insurance, seasonally adjusted; reference week ends Saturday. Initial claims are already represented in WEI.
ICSA.label: Initial Claims

definition.title: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index

NFCI.interpretation: Source-standardized financial conditions: positive means tighter than average and negative means looser. It measures conditions, not an independently identified GDP contribution.
NFCI.label: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index

definition.title: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index

STLFSI4.interpretation: Source-standardized financial stress from eighteen series. Positive means above-average stress. Rate and spread inputs overlap the financial-conditions evidence family.
STLFSI4.label: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index

definition.title: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Minus 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity

T10Y3M.interpretation: Ten-year minus three-month Treasury constant-maturity yield, in percentage points. A yield spread is not the Cleveland Fed recession probability model.
T10Y3M.label: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Minus 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity

WEI.interpretation: A source-produced composite of ten indicators, scaled to four-quarter GDP growth. It includes initial and continuing claims. It is not an official Federal Reserve forecast or a separate independent vote alongside those claims.
WEI.label: Weekly Economic Index (Lewis-Mertens-Stock)

methodology.changes: Exact 1/4/13-calendar-week baselines for weekly data; explicitly lagged daily endpoints. Never replace missing values or shift to earlier numeric rows.
methodology.legacy: Whole predecessor, source context and legacy snapshots retained. Legacy regime weights and 0-100 rescaling are not an independently calibrated activity forecast.
methodology.limitations: Current-vintage descriptive research; reference period is not release time. No identified causal GDP contribution, return forecast, sizing or execution authority.
methodology.standardization: 156 prior calendar weeks with at least 125 numeric values, or 730 prior calendar days with at least 400 numeric values. Target excluded; full returned span required; sample SD; zero variance unavailable.
methodology.weekly_reference: Saturday grid. Friday financial indices keep their original Friday date; daily spread endpoints keep actual dates and maximum four-day lag.

measurement.interpretation: Atlanta Fed model estimate of annualized quarterly real GDP growth. The observation identifies the target quarter, not the forecast publication day. FRED current-quarter values revise; historical quarters contain final model estimates, not a complete forecast-vintage path.
measurement.label: GDPNow

definition.title: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Minus 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity

measurement.interpretation: Ten-year minus three-month Treasury constant-maturity yield, in percentage points. A yield spread is not the Cleveland Fed recession probability model.
measurement.label: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Minus 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity
